postal_code.description: Postal code as printed, preserving letters, spaces, and leading zeros; null when absent.

canonical_schema.description: Transcribed loan terms; no credit decision or requirement policy.

contract_number.description: Contract reference exactly as printed, preserving leading zeros.

loan_amount.description: Principal amount and currency stated in the contract; not declared income.

borrower_address.description: Borrower address as stated in the contract; null when absent.
